run_GTNLoss: run the GTNLoss function to compute sequence-level loss between frame-level inputs and token-level targets using GTN graphs
create_GTNLossFunction_forward: create a PyTorch autograd forward pass that computes loss by intersecting target graphs with emission graphs
create_GTNLossFunction_backward: create a PyTorch autograd backward pass that computes gradients for each batch example in parallel using gtn.backward
create_make_target_graph: create a target graph from a token sequence where each token can align to one or more input frames
test_GTNLoss_end_to_end: test the GTNLoss end-to-end by computing loss on random inputs and verifying gradient shapes match input dimensions
